result.summary: GitHub Actions status: operational (checked via tools/check_github_status.py) -- attributable to code, not platform. zig build: PASS (exit 0, clean). zig build test (unit suite): PASS (exit 0, zero error lines) -- note: caught and corrected a leaked BPM_TEST_DB_URL shell-environment variable pointing at the WRONG workspace's database (port 5434, sibling workspace r-co-1) before this run; unset it and reran clean against this workspace's own DB (port 5453). tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests: PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR). zig build test-integration-exp601: independently reran (not trusting BACKEND-DEV's self-report) -- confirmed 4 of 5 tests pass: TC-EXP-601-01, 02, 03, 05 PASS. TC-EXP-601-04 FAILS, but independently confirmed the exact failure point: line 337, the INSERT INTO instance_waits fixture write itself (PgError.ServerError), which runs BEFORE the test ever reaches the quota-guard 429 assertions this fix targets. This is the pre-existing, already-tracked, separately-scoped defect noted in ISS-0617's own original diagnosis and the ISS-0622 design doc's section 6/8 -- not a defect in this fix. The fix's actual target (quota_enforcement.zig's usage reads) is confirmed working: TC-EXP-601-02's .entity_write quota-guard check now correctly resolves usage from tenant_default.instance_projections and rejects with 429 as expected, where it previously failed upstream with QuotaUsageReadFailed before this fix. PR #578 opened (https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/pull/578) for CI verification in parallel; not yet confirmed green at time of this handoff -- RELEASE-VALIDATOR should confirm CI status before final approval.
